therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: cardiac tissue regeneration and functional recovery
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with ischemic heart failure and left ventricular dysfunction
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Incidence of treatment-emergent serious adverse events (TE-SAE) composite at one month post-catheterization

results.effect_size: 0 TE-SAEs in both hMSC and hBMC arms vs 0 in placebo at 1 month
biomarker_changes: Troponin peaked at 12h post-catheterization across all arms (hMSC: 0.82, hBMC: 1.03, placebo: 0.98 ng/mL) and declined by 48h
Creatine kinase peaked at 12h post-catheterization (hMSC: 3.75, hBMC: 2.98, placebo: 4.41 ng/mL) and declined by 48h
Scar mass percent change from baseline at 12 months: hMSC -18.9% (95% CI -30.4 to -7.4), hBMC -7.0% (95% CI -15.7 to 1.7), placebo -5.2% (95% CI -16.8 to 6.5)
subgroup_findings: MACE at 12 months: hMSC 1/19, hBMC 0/19, placebo 2/21
Deaths at 12 months: hMSC 1/19, hBMC 0/19, placebo 1/21
No ectopic tissue formation in any arm at 12 months
safety_signals: No TE-SAEs in any arm at 1 month

dose_info.dose: 100 million or 200 million cells (40 million cells/mL; 0.25 mL or 0.5 mL per injection x 10 injections)
dose_info.schedule: single administration via transendocardial injection during cardiac catheterization

context.indication: ischemic heart failure with left ventricular dysfunction
